title: Crafti Attacki
description: A small client-side modpack made for fun multiplayer sessions with friends!
body:
Crafti Attacki is a light client-side modpack designed for playing together with friends.
It includes a minimap, world map, and several cosmetic and performance mods to make your gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.

Whether you’re exploring, building, or just hanging out, this pack keeps Minecraft simple, stable, and fun — without changing the vanilla experience too much.

Features:
• Mini-map and world map for better navigation
• Cosmetic mods for a more personal look
• Performance tweaks for smoother gameplay
• Perfect for small groups or casual SMPs

Have fun with Crafti Attacki! :)))
